metadata.description: Industry regulation flags for AI adoption constraints

aiConstraints.patientData: HIPAA compliance required for all AI systems handling PHI
aiConstraints.clinicalDecisions: FDA clearance may be required for AI diagnostic tools
aiConstraints.documentation: Audit trails required for all AI-assisted decisions

healthcare.warningMessage: Healthcare AI implementations require HIPAA compliance review and may need FDA clearance for clinical applications.

aiConstraints.creditDecisions: Fair lending laws require explainable AI for credit decisions
aiConstraints.trading: SEC oversight for algorithmic trading systems
aiConstraints.customerData: GLBA and state privacy laws apply

fintech.warningMessage: Financial services AI must comply with fair lending laws, SEC regulations, and maintain explainability for regulatory audits.

aiConstraints.underwriting: Must avoid discriminatory factors in AI underwriting
aiConstraints.claims: AI claims processing requires human oversight for denials
aiConstraints.pricing: Rate-setting algorithms subject to regulatory review

insurance.warningMessage: Insurance AI must comply with anti-discrimination laws and maintain human oversight for adverse decisions.

aiConstraints.clientAdvice: AI cannot provide legal advice without attorney supervision
aiConstraints.courtFilings: Human attorney review required for all filings

legalServices.warningMessage: Legal AI tools must operate under attorney supervision and cannot independently provide legal advice.

aiConstraints.studentData: FERPA compliance required for student records
aiConstraints.assessments: AI grading must be transparent and auditable
aiConstraints.admissions: AI admissions tools must avoid discriminatory bias

education.warningMessage: Education AI must comply with FERPA and maintain transparency in grading and admissions processes.

aiConstraints.procurement: FAR compliance required for AI tools
aiConstraints.citizenData: Privacy Act and agency-specific rules apply
aiConstraints.decisionMaking: AI cannot make final determinations on benefits or rights

government.warningMessage: Government AI implementations require extensive compliance review and cannot make final determinations affecting citizen rights.

saas.notes: Most flexibility for AI adoption; focus on competitive advantage

ecommerce.notes: Strong AI use cases in personalization, inventory, and customer service

media.notes: AI content generation is transforming the industry

professional_services.notes: AI augmentation valuable but human expertise still premium

manufacturing.notes: AI adoption in operations and predictive maintenance

aiRequirements: Right to explanation for automated decisions
